passage:
proposal — 提议，计划
Each proposal has strengths and weaknesses, and residents have been invited to share their opinions.

committee — 委员会
The proposals were submitted by local groups, and they are being reviewed by a committee this month.

plot — 小块土地
The garden would be divided into small plots, and each plot would be rented to a family for a small fee.

Volunteers — 志愿者
Volunteers would take care of the shared areas.

equipment — 设备
The equipment would be made of safe materials, and a soft surface would be installed under the play areas.

maintenance — 维护，保养
The city budget is limited, and the park would require ongoing maintenance.

recommendation — 建议
The committee will then make a recommendation to the council.

funded — 资助，提供资金
The chosen project will be funded by the city, and work will begin in the spring.
